context_for_next_testing_agent: All mobile responsive features verified at 375x812 viewport. CSS fixes applied: (1) Added @media (max-width: 480px) to _admin-header.blade.php for smaller padding/gaps on mobile, (2) Added pagination overflow handling to users/index.blade.php. Desktop regression tests all pass - no CSS changes affected desktop layout. The mobile card layout pattern uses: display:block on table/tbody/tr/td, hidden thead, data-label attributes on td elements with ::before pseudo-elements.
